decision.reason: [ev-c0fcac29e341] states only that a possible Envoy memory leak "using HTTPS in slow request scenarios such as high packet loss networks" was fixed. It does not say which HTTPS setup is exposed (gateway TLS termination, sidecar TLS origination or something else), which earlier versions had the leak, or any configuration-level condition. The only trigger it gives is a runtime network condition, so a declarative applicability condition can't be written from it. The upstream fix or issue is needed to identify the affected Envoy role, TLS setup and version range.
